name: Mt. Moon (B2F)
summary: The subterranean depths of Mt. Moon where Team Rocket operatives are pillaging ancient fossils. Defeat the grunts, battle Super Nerd Miguel, and claim your prehistoric fossil of choice.

items.name: Moon Stone
items.method: Hidden in the rock wall by the fossil pedestal

items.name: Dome Fossil / Helix Fossil
items.method: Choose one from the pedestal after defeating Super Nerd Miguel

items.name: Revive
items.method: Near the northern Team Rocket patrol corridor

items.name: Antidote
items.method: In the small eastern nook before the exit ladder

navigation_notes: Fossil Selection: Dome Fossil revives into Kabuto (physical Rock/Water), while Helix Fossil revives into Omanyte (special Rock/Water tank). Both can be resurrected on Cinnabar Island.
